description: Election Commission - Order to Appoint Mr. U. L. W. P. Liyanage as a Member of the Parliament
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically concerns the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to the death of a member, which is an electoral process matter. It involves the Election Commission's official declaration of a new Member of Parliament to fill the vacancy, following the procedures outlined in the Parliamentary Elections Act and the Constitution. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes, candidate declarations, and filling elected positions.
